claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- US air force removes all bombers from British military base RAF Fairford: A statement says all bombers deployed to RAF Fairford have been "re-deployed to their home stations" in the US.
- Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.
- Watch: How Brazil's dramatic election unfolded: Millions of Brazilians took to the polls on Sunday for the first round of the country's presidential elections.
- Trump unveils 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee AI policy: The president named his national intelligence chief as the taskforce's head as worries over AI grow.
- France closes up to 500 schools Monday over student protests: Lessons will be "totally or partly suspended" in some high schools after clashes between riot police and student protesters, France's education minister says.
- All six passengers presumed dead after plane went missing off US coast: The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers after significantly dropping in altitude, according to flight data.
- Supporters of jailed ex-PM Imran Khan march to Pakistan capital: Thousands have taken to the streets after talks between authorities and Khan's party ended in deadlock.
- Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit: Footage shows a drone hitting the Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.
- Forced to call him 'Dad': Trial over sexual abuse in disabled care home shocks South Korea: The BBC spoke to one of three residents at a care home who were sexually assaulted by a staff member.
- Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis: The Yemeni president's announcement comes amid an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.
- Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital: Two residents in Mekelle tell the BBC pro-government forces have taken control of the city.
- Watch: What we know about Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges: BBC Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson is near Kyiv's Northern Bridge, which has been hit for the second day in a row.
